projects.name: Nagar Sheba
projects.subtitle: City Complaint & Service Request Platform
projects.shortDescription: A full-stack civic services platform for citizens, staff and admins, backed by a 58-endpoint TypeScript REST API with SLA tracking and SSLCommerz/bKash payments.
projects.overview: Nagar Sheba is a full-stack civic services platform for citizens, staff, and admins. The backend is a TypeScript REST API (58 endpoints) on Express 5, Prisma, and PostgreSQL, with Zod validation and a modular route–controller–service architecture. Authentication uses JWT with rotating refresh tokens, Google Sign-In, email OTP, and database-verified three-role access control, with Redis rate limiting. Payments run through SSLCommerz and bKash with server-side verification, idempotent callbacks, automatic refunds, and PDF receipts. Requests follow a lifecycle with SLA deadlines, overdue flagging, and auto-close via a 15-minute node-cron job. The Next.js 16 frontend uses TanStack Query, a 4-step request wizard, and Recharts dashboards, deployed on Render.
challenges: Building JWT authentication with rotating refresh tokens, Google Sign-In and email OTP, with three-role access control verified against the database
Making SSLCommerz and bKash payment callbacks idempotent, verifying them server-side, and issuing automatic refunds
Modeling the request lifecycle with SLA deadlines, overdue flagging and a 15-minute cron job that auto-closes requests
Protecting the API with Redis-backed rate limiting across a 58-endpoint surface
improvements: Send email/SMS notifications to citizens when a request changes status
Add map-based location picking and an issue heatmap for admins
Add automated tests for payment callbacks and the SLA cron job

projects.name: RentNest
projects.subtitle: Rental Property Marketplace
projects.shortDescription: A full-stack rental marketplace with a Next.js frontend and a separate Express/Prisma backend, secure Stripe payments, and role-based dashboards for tenants, landlords and admins.
projects.overview: RentNest connects tenants and landlords with secure payments and admin oversight. Tenants can browse and filter listings, submit rental requests, pay securely through Stripe, and leave reviews. Landlords create and manage property listings with image uploads and review incoming rental requests. Admins manage users, moderate listings, and oversee all rental requests through a dedicated dashboard. It is deployed as two independent services — a Next.js frontend and an Express/Prisma backend on separate origins.
challenges: Making authentication cookies work across two different origins by proxying client requests through a Next.js rewrite while forwarding cookies manually on server-side requests
Keeping JWT access-token expiry shorter than refresh-token expiry so the silent-refresh flow in middleware never breaks
Writing an environment-aware API client that calls a relative /api path in the browser but an absolute backend URL during server-side rendering and static generation
Verifying Stripe webhook signatures reliably in production
improvements: Add in-app messaging between landlords and tenants
Add map-based property search and filtering
Support additional payment methods beyond Stripe
Add an automated end-to-end test suite for the rental request → payment flow

projects.name: ZapShift
projects.subtitle: Courier & Parcel Delivery Service
projects.shortDescription: A courier and parcel delivery platform with booking, online payment, real-time status tracking, and rider/warehouse coordination through role-based dashboards.
projects.overview: ZapShift streamlines parcel booking, online payment, and delivery tracking with real-time status updates. Riders collect and deliver parcels, update status, and confirm delivery via OTP. Admins assign riders, manage routing, and oversee warehouse operations. Delivery pricing is calculated dynamically based on weight and distance, and every parcel moves through a full lifecycle — from unpaid to delivered — with rider earnings tracking.
challenges: Modeling an 8-stage parcel lifecycle (unpaid → paid → pickup → in-transit → delivered) and keeping it in sync across three different dashboards
Implementing dynamic pricing rules based on parcel type, weight and whether delivery is within or outside the city
Building rider earnings logic that differs for in-city (80%) vs outside-city (60%) deliveries
Coordinating OTP-based confirmation for both pickup and final delivery
improvements: Send SMS/push notifications on status changes
Automate rider assignment based on proximity and load
Add a customer support / dispute-resolution flow

projects.name: LocalChefBazaar
projects.subtitle: Local Culinary Marketplace
projects.shortDescription: A role-based marketplace connecting home chefs with customers, with secure auth, ordering, and a full review system.
projects.overview: LocalChefBazaar connects local home chefs with customers looking for fresh, homemade meals. Users can browse daily meals, place orders, track requests, save favorites, and leave reviews. Chefs manage their own listings and incoming order requests, while admins moderate users and role-change requests platform-wide.
challenges: Combining Firebase Authentication with a JWT-secured API, including an Axios interceptor that injects and refreshes tokens automatically
Building role-based route protection for User, Chef and Admin dashboards
Designing an admin flow for approving or rejecting chef/admin role-change requests
Keeping the meal browsing experience fast with pagination and sorting on a growing catalog
improvements: Add real-time order status updates via WebSockets
Add analytics for chefs on their best-performing meals
Expand automated test coverage for the ordering flow
